reviews.text: I'm very happy I chose this reliable and responsive company. I had excellent communication with Océane on the phone and with Julien, the technician who came to take measurements and do the installation. I had three windows secured and I feel much more at ease. Thank you!

Delighted with the entire experience with Mon Chat Mon Amour! A huge thank you to Océane for her attentiveness and responsiveness.

The installation of the catio for Lucky was perfect! The result is impeccable, aesthetically pleasing, and perfectly suited to our patio.

Thank you also to Julien for his professionalism, kindness, and meticulous work.

Lucky is already thoroughly enjoying his new, safe space! I highly recommend them!

While searching online, I stumbled upon this company that makes safety nets, and I don't regret it at all:
My cat's life (and mine too) has changed since these nets were installed.

Until Olivier came all the way from Paris to the South to install them, I would let my cat out onto the terrace, which was just as difficult for him as it was for me. I would put a harness on him, but one day he managed to break free and try to catch a nearby bird (I live on the 4th floor), and I managed to grab him just in time. Investing in a safety system became a priority for me; I was truly terrified.

In addition, Olivier installed the structure so that my cat could walk along the parapet (the first time I saw him at the edge, I held my breath for a few moments (lol), but my cat was like a kid who can't stop going up and down his slide...). So I don't hesitate to recommend this company to all cat lovers; you'll make your cat happy, and you'll find peace of mind.

I highly recommend the company MON CHAT MON AMOUR.

Since July 2026, I've had an 8-meter net installed. Everything was quick, from delivery to installation. My kitten is happy to be able to enjoy the balcony. He even climbs on the net sometimes. I chose four openings for easy balcony cleaning.
Don't hesitate, you can trust this company.

A reputable company; the manager and staff are very friendly and helpful. Their explanations are very clear.
There's nothing but positive to say about working with "Mon chat mon amour".
I highly recommend them. Thanks to Julien for his efficiency and advice. The net was installed a few days ago and the cats are loving it!

I'm extremely satisfied with my experience with Mon Chat Mon Amour! I received a quote the same day, measurements were taken two days later, and the netting was installed in just three weeks. The price was very reasonable, and the team was lovely, whether by phone, email, or in person. The work was quick and meticulous. All four of us are thrilled! I recommend them 100%!

The Mon Chat Mon Amour team installed a catio and several safety nets on the French doors of my terrace. Finally, my three cats can enjoy being outside safely! Living on the top floor, I couldn't leave them outside unsupervised and I was constantly worried about an accident. They are now very happy, enjoying the planters, watching the pigeons... no more windows that are always closed! Thank you to the whole team for their attentiveness and kindness; you can tell they love cats and care about their safety. A special thank you to Julien, the fantastic installer!

Excellent service: very responsive, very professional, and very pleasant. I am very satisfied with the nets installed on my two windows, as well as with the interactions with the various team members!

Smooth communication. Neat work and installation. Our cat loves her new 2 square meters where she can finally roam freely; we appreciate the security and the ability to ventilate more... And no more pigeons laying eggs on our planters!
